FLAGSHIP / ORIGINAL PYTHON PRODUCTPublished · v0.1.1 · Apache-2.0

Repository evidence.
One deterministic pipeline.

I designed and published a Python CLI that turns scattered repository signals into a repeatable engineering assessment, with findings linked to source evidence.

  • Reads Python ASTs without importing or executing target code.
  • Typed, isolated analyzers feed explicit availability states and transparent scoring.
  • Console, versioned JSON and standalone HTML share one report model.

Python-first static analysis; target code is never executed.
